title: Wilf’s numerical-semigroup conjecture
statement: Every numerical semigroup with conductor c, embedding dimension e, and L the semigroup elements below c satisfies e|L|≥c.

counterexample.description: A finitely generated numerical semigroup violating Wilf’s inequality. Kunz-coordinate MILP is natural, but exhaustive computations cover every semigroup through genus 100, and through genus 120 when the multiplicity divides the conductor.
